name: Strunk
description:
Strunk is a bridge between your AI coding tool and the doc tools your reviewers already use. 

Draft a document inside Claude (or any MCP harness) where your repo, tools, and data context live, and Strunk publishes it out to Google Docs for review — no copy/paste, no PR, no asking reviewers to adopt a new tool. 

It pulls reviewer comments back into Claude with the exact quoted spans they anchored to, so you can triage and draft revisions with full context. Approved revisions land as targeted edits on the commented spans — existing comments and anchors survive the update — and Strunk replies to and resolves threads in place. 

Google Docs stays the source of truth throughout. Best for authors who write in Claude but whose reviewers live in Google Docs: PMs, engineers, and technical writers shipping specs, briefs, and docs for human review.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Strunk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Strunk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://strunk.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Strunk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Strunk provides these MCP tools: apply_revisions, get_preferences, get_version, get_workflow, inspect_doc, pick_google_doc, publish_doc, pull_comments, reply_comment, resolve_comment, and set_preferences.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Strunk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Strunk in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Strunk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Strunk is developed by Strunk. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
